_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Thomas Sergeant Perry (1845-1928): Imbert de Saint-Amand's The Court of the Empress Josephine and The Happy Days of the Empress Marie Louise (Scribner, 1890-91). Round 113 (2026-10-17, vetoable) added Madame de La Fayette's The Princess of Cleves (Little, Brown, 1891, 2 vols) from archive.org scans. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 33); Adam may veto. No uids minted.

tsp-la-fayette-princess-of-cleves-vol-2.author: This scan of vol. II begins at its contents page and has no title page. It is the second volume of the same Little, Brown 1891 two-volume set as vol. I (princessofcleves01lafauoft), whose title page reads 'TRANSLATED BY THOMAS SERGEANT PERRY. IN TWO VOLUMES. VOL. I. BOSTON: LITTLE, BROWN, AND COMPANY. 1891.'; the text runs on from Part III.
